content: {"episode_id":"ep-05032","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which the payer letter states was denied because precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope (R55) and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9). Per that note, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to these syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion. We request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 562.08 based on this documented indication."}
